name: aqualedger-monorepo
description: AquaLedger - Monorepo root orchestrator for React/Vite frontend and Node/Express backend.

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'backend/dist', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.rmSync('backend/dist', {recursive: true, force: true});"
